steps.name: four minutes
typed: [journal] output 1 has printed nothing for 240 seconds while it runs: the command buffers its output, which no reader can show. run it so it prints as it goes: stdbuf -oL before it, python -u or PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 for Python, go test -json in place of -v, or the flag of its own that streams; a reader change cannot fix it
